title: R2: T20-S v3 theta=0.12 scaling and crossover on an extended N grid

supersedes.what_is_retained: the analytic fixed-spectrum geometry K(theta) = V_sep expm(theta A) diag(mu) expm(theta A)^T V_sep^T of successor_20260913.t20s.generator, the exact population risk R_K(P) = tr K - tr(P K), the partial-trace lower bound and best-found upper bound on the approximation cost a, the paired PCA/ALS learners and training-loss restart selection, the theta=0 product control, the max-|t| simultaneous band over the N grid with the Bonferroni-t fallback, the sign profile and adjacent-bracket reporting, and the four frozen scaling candidates {none, c/N, c/N^alpha, c/N + d/N^2}
supersedes.what_changes: a NEW protocol is opened after the September results were observed; endpoint (a) re-evaluates the OLD t20s frozen prediction on fresh seeds with the offset convention fixed, endpoint (b) selects a NEW model on fresh pilot seeds only, the N grid is extended through 6400 and 12800, and the all-of failure rule is wrapped in a declared multiplicity rule over the claimed geometries/models
supersedes.what_is_not_edited: successor_20260913/t20s and its PROTOCOL_T20S_v2.json, BENCHMARK.json, FROZEN_SELECTION.json and reductions are immutable; R2 imports generator.py and analysis.py unchanged and never rewrites a t20s artifact

provenance.observed_before_design: the September T20-S confirmation result (theta=0.12 d - a_ref outside the simultaneous band at N=1000; 5/6, 3.370 vs critical 2.984; the other three geometries 6/6) and the narrow pilot selection margin (c/N + d/N^2 CV 0.2895 against c/N^alpha 0.2907 and none 0.2975) were observed before this protocol was written. Fresh confirmation can test whether the discrepancy replicates and whether a separately selected model predicts a fresh extended-N grid; it cannot retroactively preregister the old hypothesis, and no old confirmation record is reused as new confirmation
provenance.diagnosis_reused: remote-return/mlst-successor-closeout-20260917/reports/mlst-successor-closeout-20260917/diagnostics/T20_theta012_diagnosis.txt (existing outputs only; the corrected version drops a first draft that subtracted a_ref although the frozen prediction already includes it)
historical_verdicts_that_stand: registered c/N law for x_U refuted on the archived pulse-family proxy (T20 stage B)
N* ~ 960 is a log-linear interpolation of stage-B means, exploratory only
sign reversal of d between N = 800 and N = 1600 on the archived pulse-family proxy (T20 stage C)
the analytic generator certifies nothing about the archived Monte-Carlo pulse-family proxy

question: At the previously failing geometry theta = 0.12 of the analytic fixed-spectrum family, (a) does the OLD t20s frozen scaling prediction of the paired class contrast d(N), re-evaluated on fresh seeds with the offset convention made explicit, replicate its September agreement or disagreement over the old N grid; and (b) can a NEW scaling model, selected only on fresh pilot seeds and frozen before independent confirmation, predict x_U(N) and d(N) - a_ref over an extended N grid through 6400 and 12800, where the crossing of d(N) through zero is bracketed if and only if adjacent grid points carry decided opposite signs?

hypotheses.H1_theta0_control: at theta = 0 the top-k eigenspace is a product subspace by construction: the partial-trace lower bound is exactly 0 and the best-found population a is <= 1e-8 (exact, checked by the algebraic cells)
hypotheses.H2_invariants: for every theta in the grid the eigenvalues of K(theta) equal mu to 1e-10 and trace, rank, SNR and Delta_k are unchanged, while k - cap(theta) and the interval [Delta_k (k - cap), a_best] move with theta (exact)
hypotheses.H3_endpoint_a_old_prediction: the OLD t20s frozen d-model (c/N + d/N^2 on d - a_ref), re-evaluated on fresh seeds at the old grid with the CURRENT algebraic a_ref added exactly once, is inside the simultaneous band at every old-grid N at theta = 0.12; the same evaluation at the reference geometry theta = 0.25 is reported. Extrapolations to N = 6400 and 12800 are reported and labelled as extrapolations but are not part of the old-grid confirmatory claim
hypotheses.H4_endpoint_b_new_model: a model selected only on fresh pilot seeds under the declared out-of-sample rule and frozen before confirmation predicts x_U(N) and d(N) - a_ref(theta) on the full extended grid; 'none' is a valid and reportable frozen outcome; every non-'none' candidate has at most two parameters and no free intercept
hypotheses.H5_crossover_descriptive: the sign profile of d(N) over the extended grid within each geometry; a crossing is bracketed only when two ADJACENT grid N carry decided opposite signs. If no adjacent pair has decided opposite signs the package reports the grid bound and claims no crossing. A crossing is never interpolated and the grid is never extended to chase a favourable sign
hypotheses.H6_multiplicity: the claimed geometries/models form a predeclared family (theta = 0.12 primary, theta = 0.25 reference, two targets per endpoint); a claim is supported only if the all-of rule holds for that claim AND the per-claim simultaneous band uses alpha divided by the number of predeclared claims. theta = 0 is a control and contributes no claim
hypotheses.H7_offset_convention: the offset a_ref is applied EXACTLY ONCE. The t20s stored prediction_at_grid already contains the old geometry's a_ref (successor_20260913/t20s/runner.py:371 pred = pred + a_best_found); R2 rebuilds each prediction from the original (c, d) and the current algebraic a_ref and never reuses a stored offset-bearing prediction as a base. A double application is detectable and is rejected at reduce (exit 4)

independent_unit: one replicate seed. A seed indexes one paired dataset across all (theta, N) cells of its phase; within a seed the datasets of different (theta, N) cells are independent draws from disjoint substreams, and within a cell BOTH learners see the same z_i (paired). Inference resamples seeds jointly across the N grid within each geometry. Pilot and confirmation seeds are disjoint and are never both used to select a model.

estimands.R_K(P): tr K - tr(P K), the exact population risk of a rank-k orthogonal projector under K(theta) (units: whitened variance)
estimands.R_U_star: R_K(P*_U), P*_U = top-k eigenprojector of K (closed form)
estimands.a_lower_bound: Delta_k (k - cap(theta)), cap = min{k, sum_{i<=k_c} lambda_i(M_c), sum_{i<=k_t} lambda_i(M_t)} with M_c, M_t the partial traces of P*_U (valid for EVERY product projector; MLST Prop 3.6)
estimands.a_best_found: R_K(P_F^best) - R_U_star with P_F^best the best of (R_pop + 1) population-ALS restarts on K; an UPPER bound on a. a is reported as the interval [a_lower_bound, a_best_found]; restart agreement is not a certificate
estimands.x_U: R_K(P_U_hat) - R_U_star, excess risk of top-k PCA of the centred sample second moment; exact and >= 0
estimands.x_F_ref: R_K(P_F_hat) - R_K(P_F^best), reference-relative excess risk of the training-loss-selected separable ALS fit; may be negative because the reference is best-found, not certified
estimands.d: R_K(P_F_hat) - R_K(P_U_hat), the paired class contrast. Identity d = a_best_found + x_F_ref - x_U exactly (residual recorded)
estimands.d_minus_a_ref: d(N) - a_best_found(theta); the target the old frozen scaling model was fitted to. It is the basis of the offset convention: a scaling model of d_minus_a_ref is applied by adding a_ref exactly once
estimands.restart_spread_risk: max - min over the R restarts of R_K of the restart's product projector; when >= |d| in a cell the cell is flagged unresolved between sampling and optimization error
estimands.old_frozen_prediction: the t20s pilot-selected model c/N + d/N^2 with per-theta (c, d) from FROZEN_SELECTION.json, retained unmodified; R2 evaluates c/N + d/N^2 + a_ref_current(theta)

controls.theta0_a_zero: theta = 0 algebraic cells: a_lower_bound must be exactly 0 and a_best_found <= 1e-8
controls.spectrum_fixed: every algebraic cell records max |eig(K(theta)) - mu| and requires <= 1e-10
controls.nonseparability_moves: k - cap(theta) pairwise distinct across the theta grid (tolerance 1e-6); a theta that fails any invariant is recorded as excluded and dropped from inference, never re-tuned on outcomes
controls.bound_order: a_lower_bound <= a_best_found in every theta (a violation is a code defect, rejected at reduce with exit 4)
controls.identity: |d - (a_best_found + x_F_ref - x_U)| <= 1e-9 in every fit cell
controls.training_loss_selection: the selected restart equals argmin of the recorded restart training losses in every fit cell
controls.reference_consistency: the reference quantities recorded in a fit cell equal those of the algebraic cell of the same theta to 1e-9
controls.offset_applied_once: a control cell recomputes the old prediction from its original (c, d) and the old offset, verifies stored = base + a_ref exactly once, and verifies that base + 2 a_ref (the double-application trap) is numerically distinct whenever a_ref is nonzero
controls.old_selection_margins: a control cell recomputes the archived pilot CV margins from the stored t20s cv_error values and verifies the reported distinction (margin over none 2.7% versus the smaller margin over c/N^alpha)
controls.grid_and_offset_catalogue: a control cell verifies the declared old grid, extended grid and required geometries against the protocol record

inference.rule: per geometry and per target, a max-|t| (studentized) bootstrap over seeds jointly across the N grid, 2000 replicates, fixed seed; simultaneous 95% band m_N +/- q SE_N; a Bonferroni-t band (alpha / (2 n_N), n - 1 df) is computed alongside and becomes the reported band only when fewer than half of the bootstrap replicates are valid (documented fallback)
inference.min_seeds_note: below 8 seeds per geometry the studentized bootstrap is degenerate; the Bonferroni-t band is then the reported band; production has 16 pilot and 24 confirmation seeds, the fixture always uses the fallback
inference.profile: per-N sign decided by the simultaneous band (+, -, 0 undetermined); adjacent brackets are pairs of adjacent grid N with decided opposite signs; nonmonotone profiles are reported as such; an interpolated crossing is never a measurement
inference.old_prediction_evaluation: endpoint (a) uses the ORIGINAL t20s (c, d) per geometry on the old grid [400, 800, 1000, 1250, 1600, 3200] and reports predicted d = c/N + d/N^2 + a_ref_current(theta) with a_ref_current from this run's algebraic cell, applied once. Predictions at N = 6400 and 12800 are computed from the same model and labelled extrapolated_beyond_old_grid; they are reported but excluded from the old-grid claim

new_model_selection.complexity_limits: at most two fitted parameters, no free intercept (the offset is a_ref_current, a fixed algebraic quantity), exponent alpha constrained to [0, 4]; the candidate set is the archived four and nothing larger
new_model_selection.algorithm: fresh pilot seeds sorted; first half = fitting seeds, second half = holdout (deterministic); each candidate is fitted by least squares to the per-N means of the fitting half and scored by mean squared prediction error on the per-seed values of the holdout half; the two folds (A->B, B->A) are summed over all geometries; the parametric candidate with the smallest error is selected only if it beats 'none' by at least min_relative_improvement (a complexity guard fixed before any R2 data was drawn, not derived from the archived 2.7% margin); otherwise 'none' is frozen
new_model_selection.freeze: the pilot reducer writes FROZEN_MODEL.json (new selection, original (c, d) refitted on all pilot seeds per geometry, base predictions and predictions with the offset applied once, the old-prediction reference, the grid, the pilot cell digest, the protocol and matrix sha) into the run root before any confirmation cell exists; the confirmation runner refuses to draw confirmation cells unless the file exists in the same run root; the confirmation reducer refuses if the file is missing or the pilot digest changed
new_model_selection.scoring: frozen predictions are scored inside/outside the confirmation simultaneous band at every grid N per geometry; 'supported at the grid' iff inside at every N (the all-of rule); a claim is supported only if the all-of rule holds and the per-claim band uses alpha / m for the m predeclared claims

multiplicity.family: predeclared claims = {endpoint a old prediction, endpoint b new x_U, endpoint b new d} x {theta = 0.12 primary, theta = 0.25 reference} = 6 claims; theta = 0 is a control and is excluded
multiplicity.rule: Bonferroni-divided per-claim simultaneous band (alpha / m) for the support decision, plus a descriptive Holm-Bonferroni step-down over the per-claim bootstrap max-|t| p-values
multiplicity.all_of: a prediction is never called supported on a subset of the grid; a partial pattern is reported as not supported

inference.sampling_vs_optimization: a fit cell with restart_spread_risk >= |d| is flagged; a (theta, N) cell with more than half of its seeds flagged is reported as unresolved between sampling and optimization error

stopping_rule: fixed allocation: all enumerated pilot and algebraic cells, then the pilot reduce (freeze), then all enumerated confirmation cells, then the confirmation reduce; the final N grid and the seed allocation are frozen in this protocol before production. No early stop, no outcome-dependent extension of the grid, no re-selection after confirmation

failure_interpretation.old_prediction_outside_band: the September theta = 0.12 discrepancy replicates on fresh seeds (endpoint (a) not supported at the old grid); if the prediction is inside at every old-grid N the discrepancy did not replicate on the fresh seeds. Either outcome is reported as observed; a partial pattern is never partial support
failure_interpretation.frozen_none: no new scaling model is tested; confirmation reports brackets and profiles only; this is a reportable outcome and is not repaired on confirmation
failure_interpretation.no_crossing: if no adjacent pair of grid N carries decided opposite signs for d(N), the package reports the largest grid N as the bound within which no crossing was measured; it does not interpolate a crossing and does not extend the grid
failure_interpretation.prediction_outside_band: the frozen model is not supported at the grid for that geometry and target; a partial pattern (inside at some N) is reported as such, not as partial support
failure_interpretation.unresolved_cells: where restart spread is of the order of the contrast the package cannot separate sampling from optimization error; such cells are flagged and excluded from any mechanism statement
failure_interpretation.no_decided_signs: if the simultaneous band contains 0 at every N for a geometry, the profile is undetermined and no bracket is claimed
failure_interpretation.failed_or_retried_cells: charged in the ledger and never refunded; a cell missing at reduce refuses the reduce (exit 3) unless --allow-partial, which labels the output partial
failure_interpretation.offset_check_failure: a frozen prediction that is not base + a_ref applied exactly once is a code/reporting defect; the reduce is refused with exit 4 and the run is not scored

grid_catalogue.extension_note: the grid is provisionally extended through 6400 and 12800 and is frozen here before production; no extension beyond 12800 is authorised by this protocol

old_frozen_prediction.source: t20s FROZEN_SELECTION.json, target d_minus_a_ref, model c_over_N_d_over_N2
old_frozen_prediction.margin_note: the 2.7% selection margin was against 'none'; the margin against c/N^alpha was smaller (0.2895 vs 0.2907 vs 0.2975). The two margins are different quantities and are never conflated
old_frozen_prediction.offset_convention: the stored t20s prediction_at_grid already includes a_ref (runner.py:371 pred = pred + a_best_found). R2 never reuses it as a base: the original (c, d) are retained, the model is c/N + d/N^2, and the CURRENT algebraic a_ref is added exactly once. A second addition is rejected at reduce

spectrum.note: mu_1..mu_6; Delta_6 = 4; geometric tail from 3.0 to 0.02 over 250 entries; identical to T20S v2

optional_costed_expansion.note: the full four-geometry confirmation is a declared, costed optional expansion; it is NOT part of the required matrix and is enabled only via build_matrix(..., include_optional=True) (environment R2_T20_INCLUDE_OPTIONAL=1). It is not required by this protocol

fixture.note: development namespace only; outputs are development_only and never citable; the fixture reuses the full extended N grid at d = 12 so the endpoint machinery is exercised end to end

budget.planned_fits_note: one fit = one estimator invocation on drawn data: 1 closed-form PCA + R = 4 ALS restarts per fit cell. Required matrix: 960 fit cells x 5 = 4800 fits. The cap 7000 = 4800 required + 1600 optional four-geometry expansion + 600 retry headroom
budget.retry_policy: a failed cell is charged at start and never refunded; a retry is a new attempt and requires an explicit --allow-repeat

fixture_to_production_scale.derivation: measured locally at implementation time with the package's own run_fit_cell and run_algebraic_cell (single BLAS thread). Production fit cell (d = 256, R = 4, als_n_iter = 150): 1.74 / 3.46 / 6.73 s at N = 400 / 800 / 1600 (linear in N). Fixture fit cell (d = 12, R = 2): 0.0677 / 0.1179 / 0.1554 / 0.2012 / 0.2385 / 0.4652 / 0.9518 / 1.7221 s over N = 400 ... 12800, grid mean 0.4900 s. The fit scalar 30 is the ratio of the production to the fixture grid-mean per-cell times; the algebraic scalar 380 is production 1.07 s (cold, all thetas) / fixture 0.0028 s. No BENCHMARK.json is shipped with this protocol, so the measured projection is reported as unavailable rather than fabricated, and this scalar is used ONLY for the cross-check block that common.cli labels as not-the-estimate

explicitly_not_claimed: a certified restricted population optimum P*_F (best-found values are upper bounds only)
an exact crossover location N*: a crossing is reported only as an adjacent grid bracket, and if no adjacent decided opposite signs exist the grid bound is reported instead of a crossing
any scientific result from fixture (development namespace) runs: all fixture outputs are development_only and never citable

any conclusion transfers to the archived Monte-Carlo pulse-family proxy: the historical c/N refutation, the 960 interpolation and the 800/1600 sign reversal stand and are neither confirmed nor revised here
separation of sampling from optimization error in cells where restart spread is of the order of the contrast
universality of any scaling law beyond this analytic family and these learners
that the optional four-geometry expansion was executed: it is declared and costed, not required
that the t20s verdicts are revised: old artifacts are immutable and R2 opens a new protocol
